name: Webdesign Inspiration

sources.title: Submit a website — form fields and $50 express option captured via search snippet; direct fetch returned 403 (bot-blocked)
Alternate submit URL (/en/submit) shown in search results; direct fetch 403
Sister-site submission page describing shared editorial review; direct fetch 403, snippet only

conditions: Free submissions enter an editorial queue the site itself describes as taking 'a few months'; a $50 express option publishes in under 48 hours and upgrades the link from nofollow to dofollow
requirements: Site must be a live website with clean design and strong UX — this is a design gallery, not a general directory
Optional private message field for a note to the editors
preparation: A ≤150-char description — plan the copy in advance, it is very short
Optional short note for the 'Private Message' field
workflow: Fill the website URL, title (≤70 chars), description (≤150 chars), and optional private message
Submit the free form — site says 'we will review it quickly' but sets expectations of a few months
Optional: choose the $50 Express Review for <48h publication and a dofollow instead of nofollow link; payment instructions arrive in the success message
watchFor: Direct fetches are bot-blocked (403) — use a real browser or expect automation friction
Free-tier link is nofollow; dofollow only comes with the $50 express route
Free editorial wait is described as months, not days
Domain also answers at /submit, /en/submit and /fr/web-design-site/submit — same form
countsAsLive: The site appears as an entry/screenshot card on webdesign-inspiration.com gallery pages and is reachable from its category
unknowns: Whether a user account is needed to submit (form fields were visible in snippets but auth requirements were not)
Current actual review turnaround for free submissions
Whether the $50 express fee changed since the snippet was indexed
